set.title: Talina Business Center
set.description: 5-storey 'Talina' business center at Komitas 6, Talin, named after Queen Talina: offices, shops, cafes, supermarket, beauty salons, underground garage. Under construction per site; start May 2027, completion May 2028; presale 'coming soon'.

hamedilam-689.why: The rebuilt hamedil.am shows this project as 'Talina Business Center' (work-5). 'Talin Queen' refers to the Queen Talina legend the new page cites. Our Talin Queen images are this building: 1ce9073b… is the same physical model and 457741c8… and 4d7ff41a… the same renders as the images on work-5. The old data is badly wrong compared with the live page: it is a 5-floor office/retail business center, not a 9-floor 48-apartment residential building. The page shows no prices, and presale has not opened. Because it is non-residential, the editor may drop it as out of scope rather than re-label it. The dataset does have a 'Commercial' kind (21 projects).
hamedilam-689.evidence: hamedil.am/en/projects/work-5: 'Under construction Talina Business Center Talin ... Started May 2027 Completed May 2028 ... Ասում են՝ քաղաքն անվանվել է ի պատիվ Թալինա թագուհու ... Կոմիտաս 6 հասցեում վեր խոյացող 5 հարկանի «Թալինա» բիզնես կենտրոնը ... ժամանակակից գրասենյակներ և խանութներ ... ստորգետնյա ավտոտնակ; Specifications Floors 5; Availability Նախավաճառքը շուտով'. Sitemap lists only work-5 and work-6; work-1..4 and 7..10 are 404. Old image URLs still resolve (200). Google 'Talin Queen' / 'Թալին Քուին' returned no page naming 'Talin Queen'.

So this is Hamedil Residence at R. Levonyan 87-93, Talin, which is already on the map as acbaam-1116 (ACBA: 3 floors, 64 apartments, 385,000 AMD/m2, handover 24.03.2028). The old Multihouse data (5 floors, 30 apartments, completion Oct 2026) no longer appears anywhere. Remove 690 and add hamedil.am/en/projects/work-6 as a source on acbaam-1116. Values on work-6 for acbaam-1116: 4 three-storey blocks; start 1 Apr 2026; blocks finish Dec 2026 / Apr 2027 / Dec 2027; from 360,000 AMD/m2 rising to 385,000; areas 49-100 m2; 14 apartments still available; income-tax refund.
